Oatmeal Snickerdoodles
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, February 12, 2010 - 11:13pm

Ingredients




2 cups Flour
1 teaspoon Baking soda
teaspoon Salt
1 teaspoon Cinnamon
1 cup Butter or margarine
Vanilla extract
cup Granulated sugar
cup Light brown sugar firmly
Packed
2 Eggs
cup Oatmeal old fashioned, or
Quick cooking oatmeal
2 tablespoons Granulated sugar
2 teaspoons Cinnamon

Preparation

1 Mix all ingredients well about 5 minutes. Place by rounded teaspoons 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet. For topping, mix together sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle with a teaspoon over the cookies. Bake at 375 for 10-12 minutes. Cool.
